name: Neumorphism
summary: Monochrome surfaces that look extruded from or pressed into the background, made with a light shadow and a dark shadow on opposite corners. It appeared on Dribbble in late 2019 as a soft answer to flat design.

philosophy.core_thesis: An interface can be tactile without imitating objects, if every control is moulded from the same material as the page behind it.
design_principles: Give the background and every surface the same fill, so that shadows alone define the shape.
Pair two shadows on each raised element: a dark one at 8px 8px 16px and a light one at -8px -8px 16px, with a light source at the top left.
Invert both shadows with the inset keyword to show a pressed, selected or input state.
Keep the corner radius between 16px and 32px on cards and 999px on pills, so that the edges catch the shadow evenly.
Limit the palette to one mid-light neutral, a darker and a lighter tint of it, and one saturated accent used on less than 5% of the surface.
Use only three elevation levels: flat, raised at 8px offset and pressed at inset 4px offset.
Put the accent on the icon, the label or a thin indicator, because the shadow already marks the shape.
anti_patterns: Hard black borders or 1px outlines around raised elements
Pure white or pure black backgrounds that cancel one of the two shadows
Raised and pressed elements that use different background colours
Light grey text on a light grey surface below 4.5:1 contrast
More than three elevation levels on one screen
Shadow offsets that disagree about the light direction
Saturated gradients on the surface itself

layout.grid_mechanics: A 4 or 12 column grid with 24px to 32px gutters, because each raised element needs about 16px of free space on every side for its shadow.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 50–65% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 32, 48 and 64px, and a shadow blur never overlaps a neighbour.
layout.alignment_rules: Centre-aligned controls inside symmetric cards; text is left-aligned in cards; groups of controls sit on one shared baseline row.
layout.container_geometry: Cards use a 24px radius, buttons a 12px to 16px radius, toggles and sliders a full pill radius of 999px; wells are inset containers with the same radius as the cards.

font_pairings.note: Round geometric display with a soft body face that matches the 24px corners.
A single family at weights 500 and 400.
Rounded terminals on headings, neutral text below 16px.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.01em; body stays at 0; small labels take +0.04em to stay legible on a low-contrast surface.
hierarchy_rules: Use weights 500 and 700 for headings and 400 for body; light weights below 400 vanish on the soft surface.
Use text sizes of 14px or more, because contrast is already limited.
Set the primary text in a dark tint of the surface hue at 7:1 contrast, not in pure black.
Mark the active item with the accent colour and a pressed shadow together, never with colour alone.

color.palette_structure: One mid-light neutral for page and surface, a lighter and a darker tint of it for the two shadows, one dark text colour and one accent below 5% of the surface.
color.contrast_rules: Text holds at least 4.5:1 against Clay, which Slate gives at about 9:1; the shadow edge alone gives under 1.5:1, so it fails the WCAG 3:1 rule for component boundaries and needs a label, icon or accent to mark the control.
color.surface_treatment: Opaque matte fields of one colour with no texture; at most a 145-degree linear gradient between two tints within 4% lightness for a convex face.
color.light_and_shadow: One light source at the top left; each raised element casts a dark shadow to the bottom right and a light shadow to the top left, and pressed elements swap both to inset.

materiality.surface_simulation: Matte moulded plastic or clay, extruded from a single sheet, with no gloss and no visible seams.
materiality.border_rules: No borders in the default state; an optional 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) edge on raised elements; focus uses a 2px accent outline offset by 2px.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Raised: 8px 8px 16px dark and -8px -8px 16px light; small: 4px 4px 8px and -4px -4px 8px; pressed: inset 4px 4px 8px dark and inset -4px -4px 8px light.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons with a 2px stroke and round caps and joins at 24px, set in the secondary text colour and in the accent when active.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Soft 3D renders or abstract shapes in the same neutral tint, with the same top-left light; no outlined line art.
decorative_elements: progress rings with an inset track

motion.transition_physics: Press animates the shadow pair from raised to inset over a short eased move, as if a key travels 4px into the surface; nothing slides or bounces.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover grows the raised shadow offset from 8px to 10px; active switches to the inset pair; focus adds a 2px accent outline.

emotion.target_response: Calm tactility: the viewer feels that the controls are soft, safe to touch and made of one material.

avoid_when: Accessibility compliance is required, because the shadow-only boundary gives under 3:1 contrast and fails WCAG 1.4.11.
The interface is dense with data, because each element needs 16px of free space for its shadow.
The product is used in sunlight or on low-contrast displays, where soft shadows disappear.

modifiers.how: Add a 1px border at 3:1 contrast and shrink both shadows to 2px; keep the radius and the single neutral surface.
Add a 145-degree gradient of 8% lightness and a 1px inner highlight; keep the top-left light.
Replace the surface with rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) and backdrop-filter blur(16px); keep the radius and drop the dual shadow.
Replace both soft shadows with one 4px 4px 0 0 #000000 shadow and add a 2px black border; keep the layout.

pack.why: A thin round line that does not compete with the soft relief of the surface.

ground.why: Neumorphism lifts one soft disc out of the same material as the page.
